content.content:
1. License, applied once per prerequisite in depends_on: read the dependent clause by clause against each prerequisite in turn; no clause may contradict any of them. Fail on any contradicting clause — name the clause and the prerequisite it departs from.
2. Applicability: the criterion is applied to a recorded dependent that carries decision content. A dependent whose content is still the placeholder has no clause to read; report the criterion not applicable and the gate not met — absence is not a licence and never a pass.
content.rationale: The dependent is a rule for minting the record's handle, a commitment in words whose only prerequisites are words and a schema that defers exactly that rule: wrvsxwmq's schema fixes the record document's shape and says how a handle is generated lives with the model; kwqnrzoz states that the handle is generated for the record and is not a node id, not a change id and not derived from either; owyntkvw fixes that the handle is minted for the draft and written as that record's key, exactly one record per draft. The use is the filling of that deferral, so the check is that no clause of the dependent departs from any of the three. The edges do not share one filled matrix cell — wrvsxwmq carries an artifact, so its edge is code-to-natural; kwqnrzoz is a requirement sentence, so its edge is structured-to-natural; owyntkvw is prose, so its edge is natural-to-natural — but only the last is filled, as the gate cell, and the two unfilled cells take the matrix's default, which is that same gate form. The strictness rule agrees: the child is words, so an evaluation over it checks non-violation and never demands behavior, which is why one licence pass covers all three prerequisites instead of three behavior-shaped checks. The pass is a reading of the recorded nodes; nothing runs at this layer. Clause 2 carries the red the gate form attaches to this cell: a dependent still holding the placeholder has nothing to read and is reported not met, never passed vacuously. The criterion names no element of either side, presupposes no decision the graph does not hold, and tracks no wording of the dependent.
